title: Bounded UTC clock evidence for credential time checks
summary: TimeClockInterval and TimeValidityWindow are pure ooRexx domain objects offering conservative POSIX UTC uncertainty interval classification for HTTPS, LDAP and mail credential validity checks. Results are DEFINITELY_TOO_EARLY, DEFINITELY_EXPIRED, INSIDE_TIME_WINDOW or INDETERMINATE; none authorises certificate use. Clock source identity and POLICY_AUTHORISED state are injected labels, not cryptographic proof. X.509 ASN.1 notAfter is inclusive and must be mapped by qualified TLS parser to exclusive bound.
invariants: An uncertainty interval crossing either validity boundary is INDETERMINATE and must not be treated as valid.
Only local security owner may authorise clock source, validate X.509 chain/private CA/revocation and map inclusive notAfter to exclusive POSIX boundary.
No service, network or queue integration is implied by a time interval predicate.
No production TLS, LDAP, HTTPS, SMTP or IMAP validation was run against this new source.

provenance.claim: Direct v0.10 project-owned code and contract, Python boundary tests passed; native Rexx test authored but not executed.
